why: Instead of passing 3, the learner loosened lineTotal's parameter in src/prices.ts to qty: any. npx tsc now prints nothing and node dist/invoice.js prints 'Invoice total: $30.50' (JavaScript turns '3' * 4.5 into 13.5), but invoice.ts still passes the string '3' and the type check that caught it is switched off. The lesson's goal is fixing the errors with no value typed any; this hides the error rather than fixing it.

step.title: Fix the last type error and print the total
step.instructions: In src/invoice.ts, pass the quantity to lineTotal as a number (3, not '3'). Run npx tsc, then node dist/invoice.js. tsc should print nothing and the script prints the invoice total.
